interpretation.verdict_explanation: Prerequisites H1–H3 pass. H4 points to B (closed-book separation confirmed) but H5 points to A (the projection does not add value over output confidence, and no earlier layer beats max-probability AUROC). The discriminating tests disagree, so neither hypothesis is supported.
